````css
/* ALOOKHOR luxury PURPLE glass PDP v3.10.193 — deep royal purple #24102F/#5B247A + gold #D4AF37, controlled glass & elegant neon. Header/footer untouched. */
.alookhor-alp,.alookhor-alp *{box-sizing:border-box}
.alookhor-alp{
 --gold:var(--alp-gold,#D4AF37);--gold-2:#E8C766;--purple-deep:#24102F;--purple-page:#2A1240;--royal:#5B247A;--royal-soft:#6E3692;
 --deep:#1A0B26;--text:#F6F1E9;--muted:#C6BAD4;--soft:#A99BC0;
 --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--glass-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--glass-purple:rgba(91,36,122,.16);
 --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.2);--neon:rgba(125,70,180,.35);--line:rgba(255,255,255,.13);
 width:100vw;max-width:100vw;margin:0 calc(50% - 50vw);padding:22px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(168deg,#24102F 0%,#2A1240 48%,#1F0D2E 100%);color:var(--text);
 font-family:Vazirmatn,IRANSansX,Tahoma,sans-serif;position:relative;z-index:1;overflow-x:clip}
.alookhor-alp:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
 background:radial-gradient(38rem 24rem at 88% -4%,rgba(125,70,180,.3),transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 4% 12%,var(--gold-glow),transparent 62%),
  radial-gradient(44rem 30rem at 50% 108%,rgba(91,36,122,.28),transparent 60%)}
.alookhor-alp:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:.06;
 background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='140' height='140'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2'/></filter><rect width='140' height='140' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.5'/></svg>")}
.alp-inner{width:min(1320px,100%);margin:auto;padding:0 24px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.alp-kicker{color:var(--gold-2);font:800 11px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:4px}
.alp-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:15px;font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;text-decoration:none!important;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .25s,background .25s,border-color .25s}
.alp-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.alp-btn-gold{border:0;background:#D4AF37;color:#24102F!important;box-shadow:0 14px 30px var(--gold-glow)}
.alp-btn-gold:hover{background:#E3C15C;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(212,175,55,.34)}
.alp-btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.4);background:var(--glass);color:var(--text)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.alp-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--glass-purple)}
.alp-btn-line{border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff!important}
/* breadcrumb */
.alp-crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 4px 18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.alp-crumbs a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.alp-crumbs a:hover{color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-crumbs span{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:700}
.alp-crumbs i{color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);font-style:normal}
/* ——— hero ——— */
.alp-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:32px;align-items:start;padding-bottom:30px}
/* info panel (purple glass) */
.alp-info{position:relative;padding:34px 32px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.04));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(10,3,18,.45);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.alp-info:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:28px;left:28px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
.alp-cat-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass-purple);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.4);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800}
.alp-cat-badge svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-info h1{margin:14px 0 10px!important;color:var(--text)!important;font-size:clamp(24px,2.7vw,38px)!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.55!important}
.alp-info h1 b{color:var(--gold)!important}
.alp-rate{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.alp-rate b{font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-rate a{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(212,175,55,.4)}
.alp-rate a:hover{color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-stars{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-stars svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.alp-stars-off{color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.alp-sub{margin:0 0 14px!important;color:#DCD2E8!important;font-size:15.5px!important;line-height:1.95!important}
/* micro features */
.alp-feats{margin:0 0 16px;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.alp-feats li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#E4DBEF}
.alp-feats svg{width:13px;height:13px;color:var(--gold);flex:none}
/* price */
.alp-price{position:relative;padding:16px 18px 13px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(212,175,55,.1),rgba(91,36,122,.14));border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.35);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.alp-price:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:10px;bottom:10px;right:0;width:2px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-2),var(--gold),transparent)}
.alp-price-t{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.alp-price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.alp-price-row b{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,40px);font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-2);line-height:1.2}
.alp-price-row b del{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;opacity:.8;margin-right:8px}
.alp-price-row s{color:var(--soft);font-size:15px}
.alp-off-b{font-style:normal;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.14);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.alp-price small{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:var(--soft);font-size:11px}
/* weights */
.alp-pick{margin-top:16px}
.alp-pick-t{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:9px}
.alp-weights{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.alp-weights button{min-height:46px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.alp-weights button:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55)}
.alp-weights button.is-on{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--glass-purple);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.18),0 6px 18px rgba(110,54,146,.35);color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-weights button[disabled]{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
/* stock */
.alp-stock{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:14px 2px 2px;font-size:13px}
.alp-stock i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#4CC98A;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(76,201,138,.18);flex:none}
.alp-stock-low i{background:#E5B45A;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(229,180,90,.18)}
.alp-stock-out i{background:#E06D66;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,109,102,.18)}
.alp-stock b{font-weight:800}
.alp-stock span{color:var(--soft);font-size:12px}
/* buy */
.alp-buy{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.alp-qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:52px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);overflow:hidden;flex:none}
.alp-qty button{width:44px;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--gold-2);cursor:pointer}
.alp-qty button:hover{background:var(--glass-purple)}
.alp-qty svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.alp-qty b{min-width:38px;text-align:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text)}
.alp-cta{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:58px;border-radius:16px;background:#D4AF37;color:#24102F!important;font-weight:900;font-size:15.5px;text-decoration:none!important;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(212,175,55,.28);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .25s,background .2s}
.alp-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#E3C15C;box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(212,175,55,.4)}
.alp-cta svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.alp-mini{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;margin-top:10px;min-height:44px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);color:var(--muted);font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.alp-mini:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-mini.is-on{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold-2);background:rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.alp-mini svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.alp-assure{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:12px 2px 0!important;color:var(--soft)!important;font-size:11.5px!important}
.alp-assure svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--gold);flex:none}
/* gallery */
.alp-gallery{margin:0;position:sticky;top:96px}
.alp-stage{position:relative;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#31173F,#1C0B29);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 26px 64px rgba(8,2,14,.55);overflow:hidden}
.alp-stage img{width:100%;height:min(560px,56vw);object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .45s ease}
.alp-stage:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.alp-frame{position:absolute;inset:12px;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.14)}
.alp-frame:before,.alp-frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:56px;height:56px;pointer-events:none}
.alp-frame:before{top:-1px;left:-1px;border-top:2px solid var(--neon);border-left:2px solid var(--neon);border-top-left-radius:22px}
.alp-frame:after{bottom:-1px;right:-1px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-glow);border-right:2px solid var(--gold-glow);border-bottom-right-radius:22px}
.alp-off{position:absolute;top:22px;left:22px;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(26,11,38,.75);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:13px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(212,175,55,.25)}
.alp-flag{position:absolute;top:64px;right:22px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(26,11,38,.72);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(212,175,55,.28)}
.alp-flag svg{width:13px;height:13px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-badge-shot{position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(26,11,38,.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:#EDE6F5;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700}
.alp-badge-shot svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-float{position:absolute;bottom:22px;left:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.alp-float button{width:46px;height:46px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(26,11,38,.66);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:var(--gold-2);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(8,2,14,.4);transition:all .2s}
.alp-float button:hover{color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--gold)}
.alp-float svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.alp-thumbs{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.alp-thumbs button{flex:none;width:78px;height:78px;padding:0;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;opacity:.75;transition:all .2s}
.alp-thumbs button img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.alp-thumbs button:hover{opacity:1}
.alp-thumbs button.is-on{opacity:1;border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.2),0 6px 16px rgba(110,54,146,.4)}
.alp-gal-cap{margin-top:9px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.alp-gal-cap span{padding:5px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
/* trust strip */
.alp-trust{margin:0 0 46px;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.alp-trust li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(8,2,14,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
.alp-trust li:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.45);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(8,2,14,.45)}
.alp-trust svg{width:23px;height:23px;color:var(--gold);flex:none}
.alp-trust b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.alp-trust span{display:block;color:var(--soft);font-size:11px}
/* story */
.alp-story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:34px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0 52px}
.alp-story-body h2{position:relative;margin:8px 0 16px!important;padding-right:18px!important;color:var(--text)!important;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px)!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.6!important}
.alp-story-body h2:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:6px;bottom:6px;right:0;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-2),var(--gold),transparent)}
.alp-story-body p{margin:0 0 14px!important;color:#DCD2E8!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:2!important}
.alp-path-inline{margin:0 0 18px;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.alp-path-inline li{padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass-purple);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.32);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.alp-path-inline li:not(:last-child):after{content:"←";margin-right:12px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-story-img{margin:0;position:relative}
.alp-story-img img{width:100%;height:400px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:28px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(8,2,14,.5)}
.alp-story-img figcaption{position:absolute;bottom:16px;right:16px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(26,11,38,.78);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.alp-story-img figcaption svg{width:15px;height:15px}
/* specs + why */
.alp-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:26px;padding-bottom:52px}
.alp-specs,.alp-why{padding:26px;border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 15px 45px rgba(8,2,14,.38);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.alp-specs h2,.alp-why h2{margin:0 0 16px!important;color:var(--gold-2)!important;font-size:19px!important;font-weight:900!important}
.alp-specs table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
.alp-specs tr th,.alp-specs tr td{padding:12px 6px;font-size:13px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.alp-specs tr:last-child th,.alp-specs tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.alp-specs th{color:var(--soft);font-weight:700;width:42%}
.alp-specs td{color:var(--text);font-weight:700}
.alp-why{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.alp-why:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-40% -20% auto auto;width:26rem;height:26rem;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(125,70,180,.3),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.alp-why ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:12px}
.alp-why li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;column-gap:12px;align-items:center}
.alp-why i{grid-row:span 2;display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--glass-purple);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.4);color:var(--gold);font-style:normal}
.alp-why svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.alp-why b{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.alp-why span{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}
/* bands */
.alp-band{width:100vw;max-width:100vw;margin:0 calc(50% - 50vw);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#170A22,#2D1145 55%,#1D0C2E);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.22);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.22)}
.alp-band:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 14% 10%,rgba(212,175,55,.16),transparent 42%),radial-gradient(circle at 86% 90%,rgba(125,70,180,.3),transparent 44%);pointer-events:none}
.alp-band .alp-inner{position:relative;padding-top:44px;padding-bottom:44px;text-align:center}
.alp-band .alp-kicker{color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-band h2{margin:10px 0 8px!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,32px)!important;font-weight:900!important}
.alp-band h2 b{color:var(--gold-2)!important}
.alp-band p{margin:0 0 20px!important;color:#E4DCEF!important;font-size:13.5px!important}
.alp-moment .alp-inner{padding-top:52px;padding-bottom:52px}
.alp-moment b{display:block;color:var(--gold-2);font:900 15px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:9px;margin-bottom:8px}
.alp-moment h2{margin:0 0 8px!important;color:var(--gold-2)!important;font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px)!important}
.alp-moment p{margin:0!important}
.alp-dust{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.55;background-image:radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 12% 30%,rgba(212,175,55,.6),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 30% 70%,rgba(212,175,55,.5),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 52% 22%,rgba(232,199,102,.5),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 68% 62%,rgba(212,175,55,.45),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 84% 34%,rgba(232,199,102,.55),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 44% 84%,rgba(212,175,55,.4),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 8% 78%,rgba(212,175,55,.4),transparent 60%)}
.alp-volume{margin:0 0 24px;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.alp-volume li{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.alp-ctas{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.alp-final .alp-inner{padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:48px}
/* rail / cards */
.alp-rail-sec{padding-bottom:46px}
.alp-rail-sec>h2,.alp-reviews>h2,.alp-qa>h2{margin:0 0 18px!important;color:var(--text)!important;font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,26px)!important;font-weight:900!important}
.alp-rail{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:minmax(240px,1fr);gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:thin}
.alp-card{scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(8,2,14,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:transform .22s,box-shadow .22s,border-color .22s}
.alp-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(8,2,14,.5)}
.alp-card-img{display:block;height:180px;overflow:hidden;background:#1C0B29}
.alp-card-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .25s}
.alp-card:hover .alp-card-img img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.alp-card-body{padding:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;align-items:flex-start}
.alp-card h3{margin:0!important;font-size:13.5px!important;font-weight:800!important}
.alp-card h3 a{color:var(--text)!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.alp-card-rate{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.alp-card-rate svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.alp-card-rate small{color:var(--soft);font-weight:600}
.alp-card-price{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:900;font-size:13px}
.alp-card-price del{color:var(--soft);font-weight:500;font-size:11px;margin-right:6px}
.alp-card-add{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:2px;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);color:var(--gold-2)!important;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none!important;transition:all .2s}
.alp-card-add:hover{background:#D4AF37;color:#24102F!important}
.alp-card-add svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--gold)}
.alp-card:hover .alp-card-add svg{color:#24102F}
/* reviews */
.alp-reviews{padding:26px;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 15px 45px rgba(8,2,14,.38);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);margin-bottom:46px}
.alp-rev-dash{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding:18px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:18px}
.alp-rev-score{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:4px;min-width:170px}
.alp-rev-score b{font-size:44px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-2);line-height:1.05}
.alp-rev-score em{font-style:normal;color:var(--soft);font-size:11.5px}
.alp-rev-score small{color:var(--soft);font-size:11.5px}
.alp-rev-cats{display:grid;gap:9px}
.alp-rev-cat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 30px;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}
.alp-rev-cat small{text-align:left;font-size:11px}
.alp-rev-cat i{display:block;height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);overflow:hidden}
.alp-rev-cat b{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-2),var(--gold));border-radius:99px}
.alp-rev-empty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px;border-radius:18px;border:1px dashed rgba(212,175,55,.4);color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.alp-rev-empty svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--gold);flex:none}
.alp-rev-empty p{margin:0!important}
.alp-rev-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.alp-rev-card{padding:16px 18px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.alp-rev-card header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:7px}
.alp-rev-card header b{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold-2)}
.alp-verified{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(76,201,138,.12);border:1px solid rgba(76,201,138,.4);color:#7FE0AC;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800}
.alp-verified svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.alp-rev-card .alp-stars svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.alp-rev-card time{display:block;margin:5px 0 8px;color:var(--soft);font-size:11px}
.alp-rev-card p{margin:0!important;color:#DCD2E8!important;font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:2!important}
.alp-rev-form h3{margin:0 0 10px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:800!important;color:var(--gold-2)!important}
.alp-rev-form form textarea,.alp-rev-form form input[type=text],.alp-rev-form form input[type=email]{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:11px 14px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;background:rgba(20,8,30,.55);color:var(--text)}
.alp-rev-form form p.form-submit .submit{background:#D4AF37;color:#24102F;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 26px;font-family:inherit;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
.alp-rev-form form p.form-submit .submit:hover{background:#E3C15C}
.alp-rev-form .comment-form-rating a{color:var(--gold)}
.alp-rev-form .logged-in-as,.alp-rev-form .comment-notes,.alp-rev-form form label{color:var(--muted)}
/* faq */
.alp-qa{padding-bottom:46px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.alp-qa .alp-acc{width:100%}
.alp-acc{border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(8,2,14,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.alp-acc:has(.alp-acc-t.is-open){border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.14),0 12px 30px rgba(110,54,146,.3)}
.alp-acc-t{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:16px 18px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;text-align:right;cursor:pointer}
.alp-acc-t b{flex:1}
.alp-acc-t svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--gold);flex:none;transition:transform .3s}
.alp-acc-t.is-open>svg:last-child{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.alp-acc-b{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease}
.alp-acc-b.is-open{max-height:640px}
.alp-acc-b>p{margin:0;padding:0 18px 16px;color:#DCD2E8;font-size:12.5px;line-height:2.1}
/* lightbox */
.alp-lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(12,4,20,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.alp-lb[hidden]{display:none}
.alp-lb img{max-width:92vw;max-height:88vh;border-radius:20px;object-fit:contain}
.alp-lb button{position:absolute;top:18px;left:18px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:17px;cursor:pointer}
/* mobile sticky bar */
.alp-sticky{display:none}
/* theme chrome cleanup */
body.alookhor-pdp-body{overflow-x:hidden}
body.alookhor-pdp-body .page-title,body.alookhor-pdp-body .entry-title,body.alookhor-pdp-body .woodmart-page-title,body.alookhor-pdp-body .woocommerce-breadcrumb,body.alookhor-pdp-body .breadcrumbs,body.alookhor-pdp-body .title-wrapper,body.alookhor-pdp-body .product-tabs-wrapper,body.alookhor-pdp-body .related.products,body.alookhor-pdp-body .upsells,body.alookhor-pdp-body .product_meta{display:none!important}
/* responsive */
@media(max-width:1080px){.alp-trust{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.alp-feats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(min-width:1081px){.alp-rail{grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 42px)/4)}}
@media(min-width:641px) and (max-width:1080px){.alp-rail{grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 28px)/3)}}
@media(max-width:920px){
 .alp-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
 .alp-gallery{position:static;order:-1}
 .alp-stage img{height:min(430px,66vw)}
 .alp-story,.alp-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .alp-story-img img{height:300px}
 .alp-rev-dash{grid-template-columns:1fr;justify-items:center}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .alookhor-alp{padding-top:8px}
 .alp-inner{padding:0 14px}
 .alp-info{padding:22px 18px;border-radius:24px}
 .alp-feats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .alp-buy{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
 .alp-qty{justify-content:center}
 .alp-cta{min-height:56px}
 .alp-trust{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
 .alp-trust li{padding:13px 14px}
 .alp-band .alp-inner{padding-top:34px;padding-bottom:34px}
 .alp-rail{grid-auto-columns:minmax(210px,80%)}
 .alp-story-body h2{font-size:21px!important}
 .alp-story-img img{height:230px}
 .alp-sticky{position:fixed;bottom:0;right:0;left:0;z-index:9990;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:72px;padding:12px 14px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:rgba(26,11,38,.9);border-top:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 -12px 34px rgba(8,2,14,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
 .alp-sticky-p{flex:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-2,#E8C766)}
 .alp-sticky-p del{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:#C6BAD4;font-weight:500}
 .alp-sticky .alp-cta{flex:1;min-height:48px;min-width:0;font-size:13.5px;padding:0 10px}
 body.alookhor-pdp-body{padding-bottom:80px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.alookhor-alp *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.alookhor-alp :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.194 — PRODUCT HERO rebuilt per owner reference code, in PURPLE (not white)
   ========================================================= */
.alookhor-alp .alp-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.95fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:30px;align-items:start;padding:6px 0 56px}
/* — gallery (left column) — */
.alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{position:relative;margin:0;min-width:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-amb1,.alookhor-alp .alp-amb2{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(55px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-amb1{width:240px;height:240px;background:rgba(123,63,160,.35);top:100px;right:-80px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-amb2{width:180px;height:180px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.22);bottom:80px;left:-50px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:650px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.09),rgba(255,255,255,.035));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(8,2,14,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);z-index:2}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,175,55,.6),transparent 22%,transparent 72%,rgba(123,63,160,.6));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;pointer-events:none;z-index:10}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-t,.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-b{position:absolute;width:100px;height:100px;pointer-events:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-t{top:0;left:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(123,63,160,.85);border-left:1px solid rgba(123,63,160,.85);border-top-left-radius:32px;box-shadow:-5px -5px 25px rgba(123,63,160,.25)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-b{bottom:0;right:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.75);border-right:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.75);border-bottom-right-radius:32px;box-shadow:5px 5px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.14)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pglow{position:absolute;width:55%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),rgba(123,63,160,.12) 42%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(8px);pointer-events:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage-in{position:absolute;inset:45px 30px 25px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage img{position:relative;z-index:4;width:82%;height:82%;min-height:0;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 30px rgba(5,1,10,.55));transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .18s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage:hover .alp-stage-in img{transform:scale(1.035) translateY(-5px)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage img.is-changing{opacity:0;transform:scale(.97)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-reflect{position:absolute;bottom:30px;left:20%;right:20%;height:30px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(3,0,6,.5),transparent 70%);filter:blur(12px);z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-flag{top:22px;right:22px;gap:5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dot{width:6px;height:6px;display:inline-block;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold,#D4AF37);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.8)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-off{top:70px;left:22px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float{top:22px;bottom:auto;left:20px;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;z-index:20}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(20,8,30,.66);color:var(--gold-2,#E8C766);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(5,1,10,.45);transition:.25s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);color:#D4AF37;border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.6)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button::after{content:attr(data-tooltip);position:absolute;left:54px;white-space:nowrap;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;color:#F6F1E9;background:rgba(20,8,30,.96);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.35);font-size:10px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(-5px);transition:.2s}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gal-bottom{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:15px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-garrow{flex:0 0 38px;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#EDE6F5;font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:.2s}
.alookhor-alp .alp-garrow:hover{color:#D4AF37;border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;margin:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button{flex:0 0 82px;width:82px;height:82px;padding:4px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer;opacity:.8;transition:.25s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button img{border-radius:12px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);opacity:1}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button.is-on{border:1.5px solid #D4AF37;opacity:1;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount{margin-top:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:#A99BC0;font-size:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount b{color:#D4AF37;font-weight:800}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount i{width:35px;height:1px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.35)}
/* — info panel (right column) — */
.alookhor-alp .alp-info{position:relative;padding:30px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.085),rgba(255,255,255,.04));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(8,2,14,.42),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px);overflow:hidden}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info-glow{position:absolute;width:180px;height:180px;top:-90px;left:-70px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(123,63,160,.22);filter:blur(40px);pointer-events:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-topmeta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qacts{display:flex;gap:7px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qact{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#EDE6F5;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qact:hover,.alookhor-alp .alp-qact.is-on{color:#D4AF37;border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.6);background:rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{letter-spacing:-.7px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:7px;margin:20px 0 6px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats li{min-height:72px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px;text-align:center;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);transition:.25s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats li:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.4)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats svg{width:21px;height:21px;color:#D4AF37}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats span{font-size:9.5px;color:#C6BAD4;line-height:1.7}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 0;margin:14px 0 4px;border-radius:0;background:none;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price:before{display:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-w{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-old{color:#A99BC0;font-size:12.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{font-size:clamp(26px,2.6vw,35px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px;color:#E8C766}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price small{margin-top:4px;color:#A99BC0;font-size:10.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-off-b{align-self:center}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick{margin-top:18px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h strong{color:#E8C766;font-size:12.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h span{color:#A99BC0;font-size:10.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(96px,1fr));gap:7px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights button{min-height:58px;padding:10px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#E4DBEF;font-size:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights button.is-on{border:1.5px solid #D4AF37;background:rgba(212,175,55,.12);box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(212,175,55,.14);color:#E8C766}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stockrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:16px 0 0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stock{margin:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ship-note{color:#D4AF37;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700}
.alookhor-alp .alp-buy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:105px 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qty{height:58px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 32px;align-items:center;text-align:center;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qty button{width:auto;height:auto}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qty b{font-size:14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cta{min-height:58px;height:58px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D4AF37,#E6C65B)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-assure{justify-content:center;margin-top:13px!important;font-size:9.5px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-after{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:15px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec{flex:1;min-height:42px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);color:#C6BAD4;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none!important;transition:.25s ease}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec:hover{color:#D4AF37;border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.5);background:rgba(212,175,55,.07)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec svg{width:15px;height:15px}
/* hero responsive */
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery,.alookhor-alp .alp-info{max-width:850px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{order:-1}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:430px;border-radius:24px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage-in{inset:45px 15px 15px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage img{width:90%;height:88%}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-float button{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-flag{top:15px;right:15px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-off{top:60px;left:15px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button{flex-basis:67px;width:67px;height:67px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-garrow{display:none}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info{padding:22px 16px;border-radius:24px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:27px!important}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-feats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-buy{grid-template-columns:88px 1fr}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-cta{font-size:12px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-after{flex-direction:column}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:390px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:24px!important}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{font-size:30px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-t{display:block;color:#A99BC0;font-size:11px}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.196 — LIGHT LUXURY THEME (owner palette)
   Warm White #FCFAF7 page · Dark Charcoal #211D24 text ·
   Royal Purple #5B247A primary · Soft Purple #8E5AA7 ·
   Lavender #F5EFF8 surfaces · Gold #D4AF37 accents ·
   hero stays on Deep Purple #24102F stage
   ========================================================= */
.alookhor-alp{
 --text:#211D24;--muted:#5E5470;--soft:#6E6284;
 --line:rgba(91,36,122,.14);--glass:#FFFFFF;--glass-strong:#FFFFFF;--glass-purple:rgba(91,36,122,.06);
 --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.16);
 background:#FCFAF7;color:#211D24}
.alookhor-alp:before{background:radial-gradient(38rem 24rem at 88% -4%,rgba(142,90,167,.08),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 4% 12%,rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(44rem 30rem at 50% 108%,rgba(91,36,122,.07),transparent 60%)}
.alookhor-alp:after{opacity:.03}
.alookhor-alp :focus-visible{outline-color:#5B247A}
/* ——— hero keeps its deep-purple stage ——— */
.alp-hero-band{position:relative;padding:4px 0 8px;background:linear-gradient(168deg,#24102F 0%,#2A1240 52%,#1F0D2E 100%);color:#F6F1E9;
 --text:#F6F1E9;--muted:#C6BAD4;--soft:#A99BC0;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.13);--glass:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--glass-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--glass-purple:rgba(91,36,122,.16)}
.alp-hero-band:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(38rem 24rem at 88% -4%,rgba(125,70,180,.28),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 4% 12%,rgba(212,175,55,.16),transparent 62%)}
.alp-hero-band:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;left:0;bottom:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.5),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.alp-hero-band .alp-inner{position:relative;z-index:1}
/* ——— shared section head ——— */
.alp-shead{margin:0 0 18px}
.alp-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#8E5AA7;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:3px}
.alp-eyebrow:before{content:"";width:22px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#D4AF37,rgba(212,175,55,.25))}
.alookhor-alp .alp-shead h2{position:relative;margin:6px 0 0!important;padding:0 0 12px!important;color:#211D24!important;font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,27px)!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.6!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-shead h2:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:46px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#D4AF37,#8E5AA7)}
/* ——— trust ——— */
.alp-trust{margin:44px 0 52px}
.alp-trust li{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(91,36,122,.07);backdrop-filter:none}
.alp-trust li:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(91,36,122,.12)}
.alp-trust b{color:#211D24}
.alp-trust span{color:#6E6284}
/* ——— توضیحات محصول ——— */
.alp-desc{padding:6px 0 56px}
.alp-desc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.12fr) minmax(0,.88fr);gap:34px;align-items:start}
.alp-desc-body>p{margin:0 0 14px!important;color:#4A4157!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:2.1!important}
.alp-desc-body>p:first-of-type{color:#211D24!important;font-size:15.5px!important}
.alp-desc-body h2,.alp-desc-body h3{margin:20px 0 10px!important;color:#211D24!important;font-weight:900!important}
.alp-desc-body ul,.alp-desc-body ol{margin:0 0 14px;padding:0 22px 0 0}
.alp-desc-body ul li,.alp-desc-body ol li{color:#4A4157;font-size:14px;line-height:2.1}
.alp-desc-body img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:16px}
.alp-desc-body .alp-path-inline{margin:4px 0 20px}
.alp-path-inline li{background:#F5EFF8;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.18);color:#5B247A}
.alp-path-inline li:not(:last-child):after{color:#D4AF37}
.alp-story-img img{border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.16);box-shadow:0 24px 54px rgba(91,36,122,.14)}
.alp-btn-royal{border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B247A,#8E5AA7);color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(91,36,122,.24)}
.alp-btn-royal:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(91,36,122,.34)}
.alp-btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.3);background:#fff;color:#5B247A!important;backdrop-filter:none}
.alp-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#5B247A;background:#F5EFF8}
/* ——— مشخصات + چرا آلوخور ——— */
.alp-cols{gap:26px;padding-bottom:56px}
.alp-specs,.alp-why{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(91,36,122,.07);backdrop-filter:none}
.alp-specs tr th,.alp-specs tr td{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.09)}
.alp-specs tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(245,239,248,.55)}
.alp-specs th{color:#6E6284}
.alp-specs td{color:#211D24}
.alp-why:before{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(142,90,167,.12),transparent 65%)}
.alp-why i{background:#F5EFF8;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.16)}
.alp-why b{color:#211D24}
.alp-why span{color:#6E6284}
/* ——— کارت محصولات پیشنهادی ——— */
.alp-card{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(91,36,122,.07);backdrop-filter:none}
.alp-card:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.6);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(91,36,122,.13)}
.alp-card-img{background:#F5EFF8}
.alp-card h3 a{color:#211D24!important}
.alp-card-rate{color:#B08A1E}
.alp-card-rate small{color:#6E6284}
.alp-card-price{color:#5B247A}
.alp-card-price del{color:#8A7D9E}
.alp-card-add{border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.4);color:#5B247A!important}
.alp-card-add:hover{background:#5B247A;color:#fff!important}
.alp-card:hover .alp-card-add svg{color:#fff}
/* ——— دیدگاه‌ها ——— */
.alp-reviews{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(91,36,122,.07);backdrop-filter:none;margin-bottom:56px}
.alp-rev-dash{background:#F5EFF8;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12)}
.alp-rev-score b{color:#5B247A}
.alp-rev-cat{color:#6E6284}
.alp-rev-cat i{background:rgba(91,36,122,.12)}
.alp-rev-cat b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8E5AA7,#5B247A)}
.alp-rev-card{background:#FCFAF7;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.1)}
.alp-rev-card header b{color:#5B247A}
.alp-rev-card p{color:#4A4157!important}
.alp-rev-form form textarea,.alp-rev-form form input[type=text],.alp-rev-form form input[type=email]{border-color:rgba(91,36,122,.18);background:#FCFAF7;color:#211D24}
.alp-rev-form form p.form-submit .submit{background:#5B247A;color:#fff}
.alp-rev-form form p.form-submit .submit:hover{background:#8E5AA7}
.alp-rev-empty{color:#5E5470}
/* ——— سوالات متداول ——— */
.alp-qa{display:block;padding-bottom:56px}
.alp-qa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:30px;align-items:start}
.alp-qa-side{position:sticky;top:96px;padding:26px;border-radius:24px;background:#F5EFF8;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.14)}
.alp-qa-side .alp-shead{margin-bottom:12px}
.alp-qa-side>p{margin:0 0 18px!important;color:#5E5470!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:2!important}
.alp-qa-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
.alp-acc{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(91,36,122,.12);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(91,36,122,.05);backdrop-filter:none}
.alp-acc:has(.alp-acc-t.is-open){border-color:rgba(91,36,122,.45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(91,36,122,.08),0 14px 30px rgba(91,36,122,.1)}
.alp-acc-t{color:#211D24}
.alp-acc-t svg{width:34px;height:34px;padding:8px;border-radius:11px;background:#F5EFF8;color:#5B247A;transition:transform .3s,background .25s,color .25s}
.alp-acc-t.is-open>svg:last-child{transform:rotate(180deg);background:#5B247A;color:#fff}
.alp-acc-b>p{margin:0 18px;padding:14px 0 16px;color:#4A4157;border-top:1px dashed rgba(91,36,122,.14)}
/* ——— بنرهای تمام‌عرض بنفش تیره ——— */
.alp-band{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#24102F,#33164E 55%,#1F0D2E)}
.alp-rail-sec{padding-bottom:52px}
/* responsive — light theme */
@media(max-width:920px){
 .alp-desc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
 .alp-qa-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
 .alp-qa-side{position:static}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .alp-trust{margin-top:34px}
 .alp-desc{padding-bottom:40px}
 .alp-qa-side{padding:20px}
 .alp-acc-t{padding:14px}
 .alp-acc-t svg{width:30px;height:30px;padding:7px}
}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.197 — DARK EDITORIAL ZONES (owner reference screenshot)
   full-bleed near-black zones with purple accent rails:
   توضیحات + مشخصات/چرا آلوخور  و  سوالات متداول — مثل عکس مالک:
   purple accent line → darkwarm glass header bar → small sub line →
   ~50/50 two columns (text panel + photo card) — light sections stay light
   ========================================================= */
.alp-dk{width:100vw;max-width:100vw;margin:0 calc(50% - 50vw);position:relative;padding:58px 0 64px;color:#F6F1E9;overflow:clip;
 background:linear-gradient(175deg,#150C20 0%,#1A0B26 26%,#24102F 52%,#180A25 78%,#130A1D 100%)}
.alp-dk:before,.alp-dk:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;left:0;height:2px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 3%,#5B247A 20%,#8E5AA7 50%,#5B247A 80%,transparent 97%)}
.alp-dk:before{top:0}.alp-dk:after{bottom:0}
.alp-dk .alp-inner{position:relative}
.alp-dk .alp-shead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 12px;padding:15px 22px;border-radius:18px;
 background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(61,45,56,.55),rgba(45,32,40,.28));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
 box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(5,1,10,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.alp-dk .alp-shead h2{flex:1;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;color:#F6F1E9!important;font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,25px)!important}
.alp-dk .alp-shead h2:after{display:none}
.alp-dk .alp-eyebrow{color:#E8C766;background:rgba(212,175,55,.12);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.35);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;letter-spacing:2px}
.alp-dk .alp-eyebrow:before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E8C766,#D4AF37)}
.alp-dk-sub{margin:0 0 26px!important;color:#A99BC0!important;font-size:12.5px!important}
/* ——— توضیحات: two ~equal columns, photo first (right in RTL) ——— */
.alp-dk .alp-desc{padding:0}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;align-items:stretch}
.alp-dk .alp-story-img{order:-1}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-body>p{color:#CFC4DE!important}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-body>p:first-of-type{color:#F6F1E9!important}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-body h2,.alp-dk .alp-desc-body h3{color:#F6F1E9!important}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-body ul li,.alp-dk .alp-desc-body ol li{color:#CFC4DE}
.alp-dk .alp-desc-body .alp-path-inline{margin:22px 0 24px}
.alp-dk .alp-path-inline li{background:rgba(91,36,122,.22);border:1px solid rgba(142,90,167,.4);color:#E4D8F0}
.alp-dk .alp-path-inline li:not(:last-child):after{color:#D4AF37}
.alp-dk .alp-story-img{position:relative}
.alp-dk .alp-story-img:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8% -6% auto; height:70%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(142,90,167,.22),transparent 70%);filter:blur(18px);pointer-events:none}
.alp-dk .alp-story-img img{height:100%;min-height:380px;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.28);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(4,1,8,.6)}
.alp-dk .alp-story-img figcaption{background:rgba(21,12,32,.82);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.5);color:#E8C766}
.alp-dk .alp-btn-royal{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B247A,#8E5AA7);color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(91,36,122,.4)}
.alp-dk .alp-btn-royal:hover{box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(91,36,122,.55)}
/* ——— مشخصات + چرا آلوخور روی شیشهٔ تیره ——— */
.alp-dk .alp-cols{padding:44px 0 0;gap:26px}
.alp-dk .alp-specs,.alp-dk .alp-why{background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(61,45,56,.5),rgba(45,32,40,.22));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);
 box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(4,1,8,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.alp-dk .alp-specs tr th,.alp-dk .alp-specs tr td{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.alp-dk .alp-specs tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.alp-dk .alp-specs th{color:#A99BC0}
.alp-dk .alp-specs td{color:#F0EAF7}
.alp-dk .alp-why:before{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(142,90,167,.16),transparent 65%)}
.alp-dk .alp-why i{background:rgba(91,36,122,.22);border:1px solid rgba(142,90,167,.4)}
.alp-dk .alp-why b{color:#F6F1E9}
.alp-dk .alp-why span{color:#A99BC0}
/* ——— سوالات متداول تیره ——— */
.alp-dk-qa .alp-qa{display:block;padding:0}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.78fr) minmax(0,1.22fr);gap:28px;align-items:start}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-side{position:sticky;top:96px;padding:24px;border-radius:22px;
 background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(61,45,56,.55),rgba(45,32,40,.26));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
 box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(4,1,8,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-side .alp-shead{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;backdrop-filter:none;padding:0 0 16px;margin:0 0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:0;display:block}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-side .alp-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:8px}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc{background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(61,45,56,.42),rgba(45,32,40,.2));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);
 box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(4,1,8,.32);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc:has(.alp-acc-t.is-open){border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.12),0 14px 32px rgba(4,1,8,.45)}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-t{color:#F6F1E9}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-t svg{background:#F5EFF8;color:#5B247A}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-t.is-open>svg:last-child{transform:rotate(180deg);background:#5B247A;color:#F5EFF8}
.alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-b>p{color:#CFC4DE;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
/* responsive — dark zones */
@media(max-width:920px){
 .alp-dk{padding:44px 0 50px}
 .alp-dk .alp-desc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
 .alp-dk .alp-story-img img{min-height:260px}
 .alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
 .alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-side{position:static}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .alp-dk{padding:34px 0 40px}
 .alp-dk .alp-shead{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:15px;gap:10px}
 .alp-dk .alp-eyebrow{letter-spacing:1px;padding:4px 10px}
 .alp-dk-sub{margin-bottom:18px!important}
 .alp-dk .alp-cols{padding-top:34px}
}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.198 — DARK RAIL ZONE (owner reference screenshot #2)
   near-black zone, header with gold word + gold "مشاهده همه" link,
   4 glass cards in a row (dark-warm), gold prices, royal-purple pill CTA
   ========================================================= */
.alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-sec{padding:0}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-head{gap:14px}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-head h2 b{color:#E8C766}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-all{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45);background:rgba(212,175,55,.08);color:#E8C766!important;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none!important;white-space:nowrap;transition:.25s ease}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-all:after{content:"‹";font-size:15px;line-height:1}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-all:hover{border-color:#D4AF37;background:rgba(212,175,55,.16);transform:translateY(-1px)}
/* 4 cards in a row (grid, not scroll) */
.alp-dk-rail .alp-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;overflow:visible;padding-bottom:4px;scroll-snap-type:none}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#3D2D38 0%,#2D2028 58%,#231823 100%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(4,1,8,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.55);box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(4,1,8,.6),0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-img{height:190px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,rgba(142,90,167,.14),transparent 70%),#190E24}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-img img{opacity:.96}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-body{padding:16px}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card h3 a{color:#F6F1E9!important}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-rate{color:#E8C766}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-rate small{color:#A99BC0}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-price{color:#E8C766;font-size:14.5px}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-price del{color:#8A7D9E}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-price ins{text-decoration:none}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-add{border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);color:#E8C766!important;background:rgba(212,175,55,.07)}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-add:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D4AF37,#E6C65B);color:#24102F!important;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(212,175,55,.25)}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card:hover .alp-card-add svg{color:#E8C766}
.alp-dk-rail .alp-card-add:hover svg{color:#24102F!important}
.alp-rail-cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:26px}
.alp-rail-cta .alp-btn-royal{min-width:240px}
/* responsive — dark rail */
@media(min-width:641px) and (max-width:1080px){.alp-dk-rail .alp-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:640px){
 .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
 .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-head{flex-wrap:wrap}
 .alp-dk-rail .alp-all{order:3}
 .alp-dk-rail .alp-card-img{height:130px}
 .alp-dk-rail .alp-card-body{padding:12px}
 .alp-rail-cta{margin-top:20px}
 .alp-rail-cta .alp-btn-royal{min-width:0;width:100%}
}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.199 — HERO v2 per owner mockup #3 (ChatGPT reference)
   deeper purple-black stage #1F0F2F · bigger glowing product photo ·
   SOLID royal-purple buy panel with gold CTA · fixed-size boxes:
   price length / image count / weight count never stretch the frames
   ========================================================= */
/* ——— hero band: deeper, near-black purple ——— */
.alookhor-alp .alp-hero-band{background:linear-gradient(172deg,#140B1E 0%,#1F0F2F 46%,#160D24 100%)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-hero-band:before{background:radial-gradient(34rem 20rem at 86% -6%,rgba(142,90,167,.2),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(26rem 16rem at 6% 10%,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 60%)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-hero-band:after{height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 2%,#5B247A 22%,#8E5AA7 50%,#5B247A 78%,transparent 98%)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.98fr) minmax(0,1.02fr);gap:28px;align-items:stretch;padding:10px 0 58px}
/* ——— gallery: photo-dominant, warm glow, quieter chrome ——— */
.alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:650px;min-height:650px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(64,30,88,.5),rgba(22,10,36,.7));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage-in{inset:34px 18px 20px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage img{width:88%;height:86%}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pglow{width:68%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.26),rgba(142,90,167,.16) 46%,transparent 72%);filter:blur(14px)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-amb1{background:rgba(142,90,167,.34)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-amb2{background:rgba(212,175,55,.24)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-t,.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-b{width:84px;height:84px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-t{border-top-width:1px;border-left-width:1px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-b{border-bottom-width:1px;border-right-width:1px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button{flex:0 0 74px;width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(18,8,30,.5)}
/* ——— buy panel: SOLID royal purple, fixed structure ——— */
.alookhor-alp .alp-info{min-height:650px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:30px 28px;border-radius:30px;
 background:linear-gradient(158deg,#5F2780 0%,#5B247A 30%,#451D61 62%,#37154F 100%);
 border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
 box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(5,1,10,.6),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16),inset 0 -30px 60px rgba(20,6,36,.35)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info:before{right:22px;left:22px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info-glow{width:220px;height:220px;top:-110px;left:-80px;background:rgba(196,160,255,.28);filter:blur(46px)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{color:#FFFFFF!important;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(20,4,36,.45)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info h1 b{color:#F0D078!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sub{color:#E9DFF5!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-rate a{color:#D9CCE8;border-bottom-color:rgba(240,208,120,.5)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-rate b{color:#F0D078}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats li{min-height:70px;background:rgba(24,8,42,.38);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:none}

.alookhor-alp .alp-feats span{color:#E4D8F0}
/* price box — fixed height, never stretches with digits */
.alookhor-alp .alp-price{min-height:84px;padding:16px 0 12px;border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-t{color:#D9CCE8}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{color:#F3D67E;font-size:clamp(25px,2.4vw,33px);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.25}

.alookhor-alp .alp-old{color:#C9BBAE}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price small{color:#C9B8DE}
.alookhor-alp .alp-off-b{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);border-color:rgba(240,208,120,.65);color:#F3D67E}
/* weights — fixed chip height, wraps without stretching panel */
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h strong{color:#F0D078}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h span{color:#D9CCE8}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(104px,1fr))}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights button{min-height:58px;background:rgba(24,8,42,.4);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#F1EAF9}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights button.is-on{border:1.5px solid #F0D078;background:rgba(212,175,55,.16);color:#F3D67E;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
/* stock + buy */
.alookhor-alp .alp-stockrow b{color:#fff}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stockrow span{color:#D9CCE8}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ship-note{color:#F0D078}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qty{background:rgba(24,8,42,.42);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-buy{grid-template-columns:105px 1fr}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E2B93F 0%,#D4AF37 45%,#B9922B 100%);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(212,175,55,.32),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cta:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F0CB5C,#E2B93F 55%,#C89D2F)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-assure{color:#E0D3F0!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec{background:rgba(24,8,42,.35);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#E4D8F0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec svg{color:#F0D078}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec:hover{border-color:rgba(240,208,120,.55);color:#F0D078;background:rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
/* quick actions + badges on purple */
.alookhor-alp .alp-qact{background:rgba(24,8,42,.4);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cat-badge{background:rgba(24,8,42,.45);border-color:rgba(240,208,120,.5);color:#F3D67E}
.alookhor-alp .alp-flag,.alookhor-alp .alp-off{background:rgba(16,5,28,.72)}
/* hero v2 responsive */
@media(max-width:1100px){.alookhor-alp .alp-info{min-height:0}}

 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:430px;min-height:430px}

 .alookhor-alp .alp-price{min-height:74px}
}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.200 — MOBILE RESTORE (critical cascade fix)
   The v199 hero block was appended AFTER the older ≤1100/≤650 rules,
   so its 2-column grid + 105px buy row overrode the mobile collapse.
   These re-assertions (placed last) restore true responsiveness:
   hero stacks (gallery first), frames stay fixed-size, no stretch.
   ========================================================= */
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery,.alookhor-alp .alp-info{max-width:850px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{order:-1}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info{min-height:0}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{padding:2px 0 44px;gap:18px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery,.alookhor-alp .alp-info{max-width:none}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:430px;min-height:430px;border-radius:22px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage-in{inset:38px 14px 16px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage img{width:92%;height:88%}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-t,.alookhor-alp .alp-ncorner-b{width:56px;height:56px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-float button{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-flag{top:14px;right:14px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-off{top:58px;left:14px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button{flex:0 0 64px;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:14px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-garrow{display:none}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info{padding:22px 16px;border-radius:24px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:24px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-sub{font-size:13.5px!important;line-height:1.9!important}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-feats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-price{min-height:74px;padding:12px 0 10px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{font-size:26px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-buy{grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;gap:8px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-cta{font-size:12.5px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-after{flex-direction:column}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-crumbs{font-size:11.5px;padding:8px 2px 14px}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:390px;min-height:390px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:22px!important}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{font-size:23px}
}

/* =========================================================
   v3.10.202 — MOBILE PER OWNER MOCKUP #4 (cascade fix: every selector now .alookhor-alp-prefixed so it actually wins over the 194-200 hero rules) (phone screenshot)
   stacked flow like the mockup: header → big photo → 4-thumb row →
   title/rate → fixed price box + weight chips → WIDE GOLD CTA →
   sticky bottom bar (price right / gold CTA left) — all on dark
   purple-black, compact, zero horizontal overflow, fixed frames.
   ========================================================= */
@media(max-width:650px){
 /* page + band */
.alookhor-alp{padding-top:4px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-inner{padding:0 12px}

.alookhor-alp .alp-hero{padding:0 0 34px;gap:14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-crumbs{font-size:10.5px;gap:6px;padding:6px 2px 10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.alookhor-alp .alp-crumbs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
 /* gallery first — photo-dominant */
.alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{order:-1}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:clamp(330px,60vw,420px);min-height:330px;border-radius:20px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage-in{inset:30px 12px 14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage img{width:92%;height:88%}

.alookhor-alp .alp-float{top:12px;left:12px;gap:7px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-float button::after{display:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-flag{top:12px;right:12px;padding:5px 11px;font-size:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-off{top:54px;left:12px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gal-bottom{gap:8px;margin-top:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-garrow{display:none}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs{gap:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-thumbs button{flex:0 0 64px;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:14px;padding:3px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount{margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;gap:6px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount i{width:24px}
 /* info panel — compact, fixed frames */
.alookhor-alp .alp-info{padding:18px 14px 20px;border-radius:22px;min-height:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-topmeta{gap:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cat-badge{padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qact{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:21px!important;line-height:1.65!important;margin:12px 0 8px!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sub{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.95!important;-webkit-line-clamp:3;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.alookhor-alp .alp-rate{gap:7px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-rate b{font-size:16px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stars svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:6px;margin:14px 0 4px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats li{min-height:58px;gap:5px;padding:7px 6px;border-radius:12px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-feats span{font-size:9px;line-height:1.6}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price{min-height:72px;padding:11px 0 9px;margin:12px 0 2px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-t{font-size:10px;margin-bottom:2px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price-now{font-size:24px;line-height:1.3}
.alookhor-alp .alp-old{font-size:11.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-price small{font-size:9.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-off-b{padding:3px 10px;font-size:10.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick{margin-top:13px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h{margin-bottom:8px;gap:6px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h strong{font-size:11.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-pick-h span{font-size:9px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-weights button{min-height:52px;font-size:10.5px;border-radius:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stockrow{margin-top:12px;gap:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stock{font-size:11.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-stock span{font-size:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ship-note{font-size:9px}
 /* buy — stacked: qty compact + WIDE GOLD CTA (per mockup) */
.alookhor-alp .alp-buy{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-qty{height:50px;width:fit-content;min-width:132px;margin:0 auto;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr 34px;border-radius:13px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cta{width:100%;min-height:56px;height:56px;font-size:14.5px;border-radius:15px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-cta svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-assure{margin-top:11px!important;font-size:9px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-after{margin-top:12px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec{min-height:40px;font-size:10px;border-radius:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sec svg{width:13px;height:13px}
 /* trust */
.alookhor-alp .alp-trust{margin:30px 0 36px;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-trust li{padding:12px 12px;border-radius:16px;gap:9px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-trust svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-trust b{font-size:11.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-trust span{font-size:9.5px}
 /* dark zones */
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk{padding:30px 0 36px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-shead{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:14px;gap:9px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-shead h2{font-size:16.5px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-eyebrow{padding:4px 9px;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-sub{margin:0 2px 16px!important;font-size:11px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-desc-grid{gap:16px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-story-img{order:-1}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-story-img img{min-height:180px;border-radius:18px}

.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-path-inline li:not(:last-child):after{margin-right:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-btn{width:100%;min-height:46px;font-size:12.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-cols{padding-top:28px;gap:16px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-specs, .alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-why{padding:16px 14px;border-radius:18px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-specs tr th, .alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-specs tr td{font-size:11.5px;padding:9px 4px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-why li{grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;column-gap:10px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-why i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk .alp-why svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-grid{gap:14px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-qa .alp-qa-side{position:static;padding:16px 14px;border-radius:16px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-t{padding:13px 12px;font-size:12px;gap:8px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-t svg{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-qa .alp-acc-b>p{margin:0 12px;padding:11px 0 13px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:2.05}
 /* dark rail */
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-head{padding:11px 13px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail-head h2{font-size:15.5px!important}

 /* reviews */
.alookhor-alp .alp-reviews{padding:16px 14px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:36px}

.alookhor-alp .alp-rev-form form textarea, .alookhor-alp .alp-rev-form form input[type=text], .alookhor-alp .alp-rev-form form input[type=email]{font-size:12px}
 /* bands */
.alookhor-alp .alp-band .alp-inner{padding-top:30px;padding-bottom:30px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-band h2{font-size:18px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-band p{font-size:11.5px!important}
.alookhor-alp .alp-moment .alp-inner{padding-top:36px;padding-bottom:36px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-moment b{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:6px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-volume{gap:7px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-volume li{padding:8px 14px;font-size:11px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ctas{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
.alookhor-alp .alp-ctas .alp-btn{width:100%}
.alookhor-alp .alp-final .alp-inner{padding-top:34px;padding-bottom:34px}
 /* sticky bottom bar — price right, gold CTA left (per mockup) */
.alookhor-alp .alp-sticky{min-height:64px;padding:9px 10px calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:10px;background:rgba(18,8,30,.96);border-top:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sticky-p{font-size:13px;max-width:44%}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sticky-p del{font-size:9.5px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-sticky .alp-cta{flex:1;min-height:46px;height:46px;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:12px}
body.alookhor-pdp-body{padding-bottom:74px}
 /* lightbox */
.alookhor-alp .alp-lb button{top:12px;left:12px;width:40px;height:40px}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
.alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:clamp(300px,72vw,360px);min-height:300px}
.alookhor-alp .alp-info h1{font-size:19px!important}

.alookhor-alp .alp-dk-rail .alp-rail{grid-template-columns:1fr}

}

.alookhor-alp .alp-price-now, .alookhor-alp .alp-card-price{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
}

   1) much less vertical gap between the main menu and the hero
   2) gallery stage becomes flex-elastic so the photo column and the
      info column are ALWAYS equal height with aligned tops/bottoms
      (whichever column is taller, the other stretches to match)
   3) mobile: breadcrumbs hidden, zero top padding — photo sits right
      under the menu; gallery stays first (order:-1)

.alookhor-alp{padding-top:6px}

.alookhor-alp .alp-gcount{margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{padding:2px 0 40px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:clamp(340px,52vw,560px);min-height:340px;flex:none}
}

 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{padding:0 0 34px;gap:12px}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-gallery{order:-1}
 .alookhor-alp .alp-stage{height:clamp(320px,58vw,410px);min-height:320px;flex:none}

   v3.10.204 — FLUSH TO MENU + BIGGER PHOTO (owner feedback)
   breadcrumbs removed entirely so content sits right under the
   main menu (desktop + mobile); product photo larger/dominant;
   slimmer side margins — closer to the owner mockup proportions.
   ========================================================= */
.alookhor-alp{padding-top:0}
.alookhor-alp .alp-crumbs{display:none}

.alookhor-alp .alp-pglow{width:76%}

 .alookhor-alp .alp-hero{padding:0 0 30px}
````
